text: Tom Sykes beat Luke Humphries 10-9 in round two of the Grand Slam of Darts and now plays Michael van Gerwen in Saturday's quarter-finals.
Wakamotoharu leads the Kyushu basho at 11-1 after day 12, with Hoshoryu moving to 7-5 by beating Fujinokawa.
England beat Australia by 97 runs in Hobart to win the ODI series 2-1, with Ben Duckett's 133 and four wickets each for Sonny Baker and Jack Edwards.
The Grand Slam of Curling National runs in Sydney, Nova Scotia until Sunday, with every draw streamed on ESPN+ in the US.
The Jets, 2-8 and on a five-game losing streak, travel to face the 1-8 Chargers on Sunday, with Geno Smith's availability the main question.
